datasets.title: Japan: Building Footprints in the Noto Earthquake Area
datasets.description: A dataset of building footprints in Japan, in the area of the January 2024 Noto earthquake. Building footprints are useful for a range of important applications, from population estimation, urban planning and humanitarian response, to environmental and climate science. This large-scale open dataset contains the outlines of buildings derived from high-resolution satellite imagery in order to support these types of uses. For more info visit open buildings FAQ https://sites.research.google/open-buildings/#faq. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/open_buildings_v3_west_japan_earthquake_epicenter]

lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from high-resolution satellite imagery covering the January 2024 Noto earthquake area in Japan using automated detection methods. The dataset provides vector outlines of building structures to support population estimation, urban planning, and humanitarian response activities.

sources.name: Google Research Open Buildings
sources.description: High-resolution satellite imagery-derived building footprints providing spatial inventory of structures for disaster risk assessment and humanitarian response applications.
